description: Header file declaring utility functions for constructing and managing gradients of while loops within TensorFlow's C++ framework. It defines the AddWhileLoopGradient function that computes partial derivatives and gradients for while loops in computational graphs.

classes.name: WhileContext
classes.description: A class representing the context of a while loop in TensorFlow's graph, used for constructing and managing while loops and their gradients.

methods.name: AddWhileLoopGradient
methods.description: Computes the gradient for a while loop given its context, scope, and gradient inputs; returns partial derivatives with respect to loop inputs.
